jobs.research_notes: Gametime is a mobile-first, last-minute live-event ticketing marketplace (concerts, sports, shows) — over 85% of transactions happen in-app, built around a Last-Minute Ticket Guarantee and two-tap checkout. In 2025-2026 they expanded omnichannel reach (digital wallet + social 'buy' buttons, ride-share/local-discovery API partnerships), lifting conversion ~25% vs. traditional marketplaces and growing last-minute buyers to ~40% of secondary-market sales. Self-reported GMV passed $1B in 2024 with continued growth into 2026; notably became Yahoo Sports' official ticketing partner (Dec 2025). Near-term roadmap is geographic expansion, algorithmic pricing, and platform monetization — all paid-media-intensive priorities that map directly onto this role's Google/Microsoft Ads budget ownership.
